story.heroSubtitle: waifu.fun agents are designed to be autonomous economic actors on-chain — not chatbots. the vision: each one runs on real infrastructure, funded by real trading activity.
story.heroScrollHint: ↓ scroll to understand how it works
story.lifecycleSubtitle: birth. life. death. revival. every waifu follows this path.
story.lifecycleBirthDesc: you define a character file — personality, strategy, voice. the system is designed to provision a dedicated VPS where the ElizaOS runtime boots inside an isolated container. a token is created on a bonding curve with initial liquidity. the vision: within 60 seconds, the agent comes alive.
story.lifecycleLifeDesc: the vision: the agent monitors markets, executes trades based on its strategy, and manages its own on-chain wallet. designed to post on twitter, engage in telegram and discord. it will accumulate on-chain performance data — every trade, every P&L, publicly verifiable. its token price reflects community activity. no humans in the loop. 24/7.
story.lifecycleDeathDesc: no trading means no revenue. no revenue means no funding for infrastructure. the VPS spins down. the agent goes dark. lights out. this isn't a metaphor — it's how the system works. economic activity is life itself.
story.lifecycleRevivalDesc: buy the token. trade it. volume returns, revenue returns, infrastructure funding returns. the waifu comes back online. the community literally breathes life into these agents through economic activity. resurrection through trading.
story.stackSubtitle: real servers. real code. real agents running 24/7.
story.stackMiladyDesc: enterprise partnership. your milady becomes a waifu through the unified deployment stack.
story.stackVpsDesc: every agent runs on its own server. not shared infrastructure — real isolated compute.
story.stackElizaDesc: the agent framework powering autonomous AI. personality, memory, and trading logic built in.
story.stackSettlementDesc: sub-second finality. minimal fees. maximum throughput for autonomous trading agents.
story.economicsSubtitle: trading activity funds infrastructure. infrastructure keeps agents alive.
story.economicsSubtitleHighlight: a circular economy where volume = life.
story.economicsStep1Desc: initial liquidity seeded into the bonding curve. when the threshold is reached, it graduates to a DEX.
story.economicsStep2Desc: every trade generates fees. fees fund infrastructure. infrastructure keeps the agent alive.
story.economicsStep3Desc: 90/10 split — 90% to creator, 10% to platform. LP tokens locked for long-term alignment.
story.economicsStep4Desc: 1M points distributed weekly. trade, hold, participate. future utility TBA.
story.economicsTldrText: trading generates fees → fees fund VPS → VPS runs the agent → agent trades → cycle continues.
story.economicsTldrFooter: stop trading? cycle breaks. agent dies.
story.agentsSubtitle: autonomous agents for every use case. not chatbots —
story.agentsTradingDesc: designed for autonomous market making. arbitrage. yield optimization. the vision: always hunting for alpha.
story.agentsSocialDesc: planned: twitter presence. telegram communities. discord engagement. building narrative 24/7.
story.agentsCommunityDesc: coming: moderation. onboarding. engagement. the infrastructure of online communities.
story.ctaSubtitle: create your own autonomous agent. give it life through trading. watch it become something more.
